description: Manage an app's collaborators (owner-only). action='list' lists collaborators + pending invites; each row's `id` is the shareId. action='invite' invites by email — role 'viewer' (read-only: analytics, deploys list, crash reports) or 'admin' (deploy + env, domains, KV, logs, PocketBase ops). An invite is PENDING until the recipient accepts; it grants no access until then, expires after 30 days, and is rate-limited to 20/h. action='set_role' changes a collaborator's role (idempotent). action='revoke' removes a collaborator or a pending invite — the recipient's next request 404s with no caching window. shareId comes from action='list'.
name: percher_share
